en: Paṭṭhānapakaraṇa:
Dhammapaccanīya (2), Dukatikapaṭṭhānapāḷi (3) 9.4.
Hetuduka, Ācayagāmattikādi
Dependent on a state that is not a cause and does not lead to accumulation … [as before] … (In all cases, nine.
Dependent on a state that is not a cause and does not lead to diminution … [as before] … (In all cases, nine.
Dependent on a state that is not a cause and leads neither to accumulation nor to diminution … [as before] … (In all cases, nine. There is no resultant.)
Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor is it of the Asekha (the Beyond-trainee), … [and so on] … (In all cases, nine.
Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor is it not of the Asekha, … [and so on] … (In all cases, nine.
Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor is it neither-of-the-Asekha-nor-not-of-the-Asekha, … [and so on] … (In all cases, nine.)
Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor limited … (nine in all).
Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor sublime … (nine in all).
Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor immeasurable … (nine in all).
Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor has a limited object … (nine in all).
Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor has a sublime object … (nine in all).
Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor has an immeasurable object … (nine in all).

Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor inferior … [all nine] … Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor intermediate … [all nine] … Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor sublime … [all nine].
Dependent on a state that is not a cause and is not fixed in wrongness … [and so on] … (In all cases, nine.
Dependent on a state that is not a cause and is not fixed in rightness … [and so on] … (In all cases, nine.
Dependent on a state that is not a cause and is not indeterminate … [and so on] … (In all cases, nine. There is no resultant.)
In dependence on a state that is neither a cause nor has the Path as its object … (nine in all).
In dependence on a state that is neither a cause nor is rooted in the Path … (nine in all).
In dependence on a state that is neither a cause nor has the Path as its dominant factor … (nine in all).

Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor unarisen … [all nine] … Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor has arisen … [all nine] … Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor past … [all nine].
Dependent on a state that is not a cause and is not future … [and so on] … (In all cases, nine.
Dependent on a state that is not a cause and has a past object … [and so on] … (In all cases, nine.
Dependent on a state that is not a cause and has a future object … [and so on] … (In all cases, nine.)
Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor has a present object … (nine in all).
Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor is internal … (nine in all).
Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor is external … (nine in all).
Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor has an internal object … [and so on] … (In all cases, nine.
Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor has an external object … [and so on] … (In all cases, nine.)
